paper_id: SecCoder_ Towards Generalizable and Robust Secure Code Generation__oa_W4404782576
title: SecCoder: Towards Generalizable and Robust Secure Code Generation
motivation: 现有安全代码生成方法泛化性差、鲁棒性弱，无法应对未见漏洞和对抗攻击
problem_framing: 安全对齐中的两个关键失效模式：错配泛化(600+类CWE)和脆弱性防御
key_insight: 用in-context learning加密集检索的safe demonstration实现免重训练的安全加固
method_signature: 四阶段框架(Expansion→Selection→Integration→Generation)，用INSTRUCTOR稠密检索器选相关安全代码作demonstration
evaluation_criteria: 安全率(CodeQL检测)和功能正确性(Pass@k on HumanEval)在未见测试集上评估
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: C++改进仅6.14%对比Python的14.99%，上下文长度限制可用demonstration数量
evidence_for_taste: mismatched generalization is one of the critical failure modes
basic input preprocessing defenses are not robust against the attack
doesn’t need to be retrained when meeting new vulnerabilities
preserve the correctness without any extra operation
The improvement of the security rate on InCoder is not as significant
thinking_moves: 从安全失效案例反推根本原因：泛化缺失和防御脆弱性
把安全代码生成重新定义为demonstration retrieval + ICL问题而非微调
发现training-free方法可同时提升泛化性和鲁棒性
通过消融实验验证ICL和retriever各自的贡献
承认C++场景效果折半的局限性
